text: Altrad completed its acquisition of Doosan Babcock Limited on 25 September 2022; to reflect the new ownership structure the UK engineering company was renamed Altrad Babcock Limited, making it part of the Altrad group.
short: Altrad Babcock is part of the Altrad group

source.name: Altrad: 'Altrad completes the acquisition of Doosan Babcock Limited'
source.quote: To reflect the new ownership structure, the business will now be renamed Altrad Babcock Limited
source.note: Same announcement: 'Altrad are delighted to announce it reached financial close on its agreement to acquire Doosan Babcock Limited on Sunday 25th September 2022.'

additionalSources.name: ScaffMag: 'Altrad completes acquisition of Doosan Babcock'
additionalSources.quote: Altrad has added 4,000 new staff after signing its financial agreement to acquire Doosan Babcock Limited.
additionalSources.note: Same article: 'Doosan Babcock which will now be renamed Altrad Babcock Limited is a specialist in delivering engineering, aftermarket and upgrade services to the nuclear, thermal, oil and gas, petrochemical and process sectors.'
